slot.brief: Given a determinant with entries involving x, factorise it into linear factors using row/column operations.

stem: Using row operations, factorise the determinant: $$\begin{vmatrix}x-2&-1&1\\x&x-3&-1\\x&-2&x-2\end{vmatrix}$$

verdicts.working: Expanding along the first row gives \(D=(x-2)(x^2-5x+4)+(x^2-x)+(-x^2+x)=(x-2)(x-1)(x-4)\).

working:
$R_2\to R_2-R_1,\ R_3\to R_3-R_1$ gives $D=\begin{vmatrix}x-2&-1&1\\2&x-2&-2\\2&-1&x-3\end{vmatrix}.$\n$D=(x-2)[(x-2)(x-3)-2]=(x-2)(x-1)(x-4).$

Independent check: Expanding along the first row gives \(D=(x-2)(x^2-5x+4)+(x^2-x)+(-x^2+x)=(x-2)(x-1)(x-4)\).
solution:
Apply $R_2\to R_2-R_1$ and $R_3\to R_3-R_1$; these operations leave the determinant unchanged:
$$D=\begin{vmatrix}x-2&-1&1\\2&x-2&-2\\2&-1&x-3\end{vmatrix}=(x-2)\big[(x-2)(x-3)-2\big].$$
Hence, $D=(x-2)(x-1)(x-4)$.
